item.title: UK forecast to see biggest hit to growth from Iran war out of major economies
item.summary: The OECD downgrades forecasts for many of the world's biggest economies due to the US-Israel war with Iran.

item.title: Zelensky visits Saudi Arabia after offering Ukraine's drone expertise
item.summary: There is renewed urgency for Ukraine to get a drone deal done, as the US increasingly focuses on Iran.

item.title: Trump's strategy is to pursue two off-ramps at once
item.summary: The White House insists the president is dictating events, but even some Republicans are frustrated by mixed messaging about his war aims.

item.title: Rationing power and diluting petrol - how African countries are coping with effects of Iran war
item.summary: The disruption in oil supplies has caused shortages and concerns in several African countries.

item.title: How a prolonged Middle East conflict could reshape how we fly
item.summary: The Gulf's hub airports made long-distance travel cheaper - but now their future looks unclear.

item.title: Paul McCartney announces nostalgic new album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane
item.summary: The 83-year-old looks back at his childhood in Liverpool on the new record, which comes out in May.

item.title: Israel says it has killed Iran's navy chief overseeing Strait of Hormuz blockade
item.summary: Israel's defence minister said a number of other "senior Navy command officials" have also been killed. Iran has not yet commented.

item.title: UK CO2 plant to reopen in war contingency plan
item.summary: The government will invest £100m to restart the Teesside site producing carbon dioxide, a key part of food and drink manufacturing.

item.title: Australia bans Iranian tourists with valid visas for six months
item.summary: Critics say the move, which comes after Iranian footballers were granted asylum, is a "moral failure".

item.title: NS&I boss replaced as savers left waiting for millions of pounds
item.summary: Pensions Minister Torston Bell said those affected would receive compensation "where appropriate".
